description:
**About Tarento:**
Tarento is a fast\-growing technology consulting company headquartered in Stockholm, with a strong presence in India and clients across the globe. We specialize in digital transformation, product engineering, and enterprise solutions, working across diverse industries including retail, manufacturing, and healthcare. Our teams combine Nordic values with Indian expertise to deliver innovative, scalable, and high\-impact solutions.  

We're proud to be recognized as a Great Place to Work, a testament to our inclusive culture, strong leadership, and commitment to employee well\-being and growth. At Tarento, you’ll be part of a collaborative environment where ideas are valued, learning is continuous, and careers are built on passion and purpose.  

Exp: 2\-4 Years
Work Location: Noida
Work Mode: 5 Days Work from Office **Job Title**: Senior Executive \- Project Management **The Role**:
We are looking for a high\-energy, detail\-oriented Project Coordinator to drive our development pipeline. You will be the heartbeat of our daily operations—facilitating stand\-ups, unblocking the development team, and ensuring that every feature moves smoothly from an initial estimate to a successful deployment. This is a role for someone who loves organization, thrives on clear communication, and knows how to "chase" tasks without losing team rapport. **Key Responsibilities:*** Daily Facilitation: Lead daily stand\-up calls to identify progress, blockers, and immediate priorities.
* Pipeline Management: Maintain and track the development pipeline, ensuring all items are correctly prioritized and moving through the lifecycle.
* Estimation Coordination: Work closely with Developers and Testers to gather accurate effort estimates for new features and bug fixes.
* End\-to\-End Chasing: Proactively follow up with team members to ensure deadlines are met and the "Definition of Done" is achieved for every task.
* Deployment Oversight: Coordinate the transition from testing to production, ensuring all pre\-deployment checks are completed.
* Reporting: Create and distribute comprehensive Deployment Reports for various products, detailing what was shipped, any issues encountered, and post\-deployment status.
* Team Management: Effectively coordinate cross\-functional teams by driving accountability, resolving blockers, and ensuring timely delivery of project milestones while maintaining strong team collaboration and engagement.

 **Qualifications \& Skills*** The "Chaser" Mindset: Proven ability to follow up on tasks and hold team members accountable in a professional, constructive manner.
* Technical Literacy: While you don't need to code, you must understand the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) and be comfortable talking to developers and QA.
* Organization: Mastery of project management tools (e.g., Jira, Azure DevOps, Trello, or Monday.com).
* Communication: Excellent verbal and written skills for leading meetings and drafting clear deployment summaries.
* Analytical Thinking: Ability to spot bottlenecks in the pipeline before they become major delays.

description:
OB DESCRIPTION – PROJECT MANAGER (BOILER PROJECTS)

About the Role

We are looking for an experienced and technically strong Project Manager – Boiler Projects to lead the execution of large and complex industrial boiler projects. The ideal candidate should have 15–20 years of hands\-on experience in boiler project execution and should have successfully handled projects involving boilers ranging from 1 TPH to 100 TPH capacity.

The candidate will be responsible for complete project execution from planning and mobilization through erection, installation, commissioning, trial run and final handover to the client.

Key Responsibilities

Overall responsibility for end\-to\-end execution of boiler and associated industrial projects.

Plan, execute and monitor projects from project kick\-off to successful commissioning and handover.

Handle projects involving 1 TPH to 100 TPH boilers, including large\-capacity and complex industrial installations.

Lead and coordinate boiler erection, installation, piping, equipment erection, testing and commissioning activities.

Review project drawings, technical specifications, BOQ, project schedules and execution plans.

Prepare detailed project execution plans, manpower plans, material requirements and site schedules.

Coordinate with Design, Production, Purchase, Quality, Service, Stores and Accounts teams for smooth project execution.

Act as the primary point of contact for clients, consultants, contractors and project stakeholders.

Monitor project progress against approved timelines, budgets and quality requirements.

Identify project risks, delays and technical issues and take timely corrective actions.

Manage site manpower, contractors, subcontractors, vendors and other resources effectively.

Ensure availability of materials, equipment, tools and manpower as per project requirements.

Monitor project costs and ensure execution within approved budget.

Conduct regular project review meetings and submit progress reports to management.

Ensure compliance with approved quality, safety and statutory requirements at project sites.

Coordinate inspection, testing, hydro testing, commissioning and performance trials.

Resolve technical and execution\-related issues at site in coordination with concerned departments.

Ensure proper documentation, completion certificates, commissioning reports and final project handover.

Manage multiple projects simultaneously, wherever required.

Handle large\-scale industrial projects and coordinate with multiple agencies and stakeholders.

Travel extensively to project sites as required.

Required Technical Experience

The candidate should have strong practical exposure to:

Industrial Steam Boilers / Hot Water Boilers / Thermic Fluid Systems

Boiler erection and installation

Boiler commissioning and trial runs

Boiler piping and associated equipment

Pressure parts and boiler auxiliaries

Pumps, fans, valves and related mechanical equipment

Fuel handling and combustion systems

Electrical and instrumentation coordination

Hydro testing and pre\-commissioning activities

Performance testing and troubleshooting

Site execution and project closure

Project Management Skills

Project planning and scheduling

Resource and manpower planning

Cost and budget control

Vendor and contractor management

Client and consultant coordination

Risk identification and mitigation

Project documentation and reporting

Timeline and milestone management

Team leadership and coordination

Problem\-solving and decision\-making

Candidate Profile

15–20 years of overall experience, preferably in Boiler / Power / Thermal / Process Engineering projects.

Proven experience in handling complete boiler projects from installation to commissioning and handover.

Must have worked on boilers ranging from 1 TPH to 100 TPH, with substantial exposure to larger industrial projects.

Should have independently handled major/large\-scale industrial projects.

Strong understanding of boiler project execution, site management and commissioning.

Excellent leadership, communication and client\-handling skills.

Ability to manage multiple teams and contractors at different project sites.

Willingness to travel extensively across India and stay at project locations as required.

Qualification

B.Tech / B.E. / Diploma in Mechanical Engineering

Candidates with relevant extensive boiler project experience will be preferred.

Preferred Background

Candidates currently working or having worked with Boiler Manufacturers, EPC Companies, Power Plants, Thermal Engineering Companies, Process Industries or Industrial Project Execution Companies will be preferred.

Key Performance Expectations

Projects completed within committed timelines

Effective control of project cost and resources

Zero/low project execution delays

Successful commissioning and performance trials

Client satisfaction and timely handover

Effective management of site teams and contractors

Compliance with quality and safety standards

Pay: ₹50,000\.00 \- ₹70,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Health insurance
* Leave encashment
* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person

Position Overview:

This is more than a job. It’s a chance to build, grow, and make a real impact! Join our team as our new **Senior IS Support Manager****!**  

We are looking for an experienced, pragmatic, and service\-oriented **Senior IS Support Manager** to lead and elevate our global IS support organisation. Based in **Noida**, you will own the end\-to\-end support experience across **Workday and all core IS systems**, with direct accountability for **Level 1 and Level 2** delivery and strong influence over the wider L0–L4 model.


This role is ideal for a seasoned leader who enjoys building modern, efficient, and scalable support organisations—capable of keeping pace with rapid growth while sustaining high service quality and strong user satisfaction. You will define and embed a global support framework spanning **Europe, US, and Asia** time zones, mature tiered support models, and drive continuous improvement across tools, processes, and people.


As a senior member of the IS function, you will lead and grow a distributed support team, embed a culture of service excellence, and act as a key driver of organisational change across Information Systems—operating with autonomy, executive visibility, and cross\-functional influence.


Location: Noida, India


Hybrid


Responsibilities:
**Support Operating Model \& Framework** Own, implement, and continuously mature a global IS support framework, including the tiered support model (L0/L1/L2/L3/L4\), escalation paths, ownership boundaries, and handover processes—ensuring seamless coverage across regions.

**Service Strategy \& Prioritisation** Set service scope, intake, prioritisation rules, and support engagement models aligned with business criticality and system risk, balancing demand across a complex enterprise application landscape.

**SLA \& Performance Management** Define, implement, and govern SLAs and KPIs; establish rigorous tracking, executive\-level reporting, and a culture of measurable, continuous service improvement.

**Global Team Leadership \& Coverage** Build, lead, and develop distributed L1/L2 support teams across Europe, US, and Asia, ensuring coverage, capability, knowledge continuity, and succession—while anchoring the team's centre of gravity in Noida. Design and manage shift and rota models to sustain reliable multi–time\-zone coverage.

**Incident, Problem \& Request Management** Direct major incident management, root cause analysis, and problem management; ensure structured, high\-quality handling of service requests and changes at scale.

**Workday \& Enterprise Platform Support Ownership** Act as the primary support owner for **Workday** and other core IS platforms (e.g., Salesforce and adjacent enterprise systems), ensuring deep functional and operational support capability within the team.

**Knowledge Management** Establish and enforce knowledge base standards, documentation practices, and self\-service enablement to reduce ticket volume and accelerate resolution.

**Tooling \& Automation** Partner with IS architecture to optimise service management tooling, workflows, and automation—driving efficiency, reducing manual effort, and improving the end\-user experience.

**Vendor \& Partner Coordination** Manage and align external support partners with internal standards, SLAs, and the target operating model, holding vendors accountable to agreed performance.

**Organisational Change \& Continuous Improvement** Champion service excellence as a change leader, embedding discipline, structure, and a proactive improvement mindset across the IS support function.


Qualifications:
* **Service Management Fundamentals** — Strong command of ITIL or equivalent frameworks across incident, problem, change, and request management, with the ability to operationalise at scale.
* **Operating Model Design** — Proven track record designing and running tiered support models and global support organisations; hands\-on experience across L0–L4 (L0 and L4 experience a strong plus).
* **Workday \& IS Systems Support** — Demonstrated experience supporting Workday and broad enterprise IS systems at L1/L2, including functional troubleshooting and escalation management.
* **SLA\-Driven Delivery** — Deep experience defining, implementing, and improving SLAs and service KPIs in fast\-growing, high\-change environments.
* **Senior Leadership** — Proven ability to drive organisational change while building structure, discipline, and engagement; strong record of recruiting, mentoring, and developing support teams across multiple geographies and cultures.
* **Executive Communication** — Clear, structured communicator able to engage technical teams, business stakeholders, and executives with equal confidence.
* **Tools \& Practices** — Strong hands\-on experience with service management tools, ticketing systems, knowledge bases, and reporting dashboards.
* **24/5 Shift Management (nice to have)** — Experience designing and managing 24/5 shift\-based support operations across multiple time zones.

**Delivery Experience** **10\+ years** in IS/IT support, service management, or operations, including **significant experience (4\+ years) in a leadership or managerial capacity** running distributed teams.
